propositions: Eight unguarded pytest-invoking CI lanes lack per-test hang protection, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind a dot in quiet mode with no traceback or culprit identification.
Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated from lane-specific historical runtime data rather than copied uniformly, with a floor of 10x observed mean per-test duration and a minimum of 300 seconds.

The parity assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must exhaustively detect pytest invocations across all workflow files using a regex that matches command boundaries and shell continuations, not just xdist lanes or specific markers.
Each guarded pytest step must carry both --timeout=<budget> and --timeout-method=thread flags, with evidence of the budget basis recorded as a YAML comment at the step.
The _optionality.yml degradation-path lane runs in a minimal venv installing only core dependencies and must have pytest-timeout added to its install line to honor the timeout flags.
